name: Ishtar
title: Queen of Heaven
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Impetuous Ishtar seeks conquests both martial and carnal. A goddess of love and war, she is equally delighted by either, sometimes treating one as the other. She views the current circumstances of Ryven as an opportunity, always at the forefront of skirmishes with hostile realms and taking partners from friendlier ones, but always more enticed by the next encounter than the current.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: [Retaliate] cannot be removed or its duration reduced.

skills.name: Unyielding Desire
skills.description:
Attack all enemies 320%ATK with an 80% chance to increase the duration of a random Debuff on each target by 1 turn. If Anu is an ally, increase the duration of all Debuff on each target by 1 turn instead.
